name: An Unsettling Discovery
summary: Claire asks you to carry samples from the cave to Ashe Amberhall at Farholde Keep. Their energy overwhelms her, and she is too weak to take them herself.

sections.title: A Request from the Cave
sections.body: Claire is trapped in the cave and says she cannot carry the samples. Their power is too much for her, and she needs to rest. You are asked to bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall at Farholde Keep.

sections.title: At Farholde Keep
sections.body: Ashe Amberhall receives the catalyst and says Claire’s instincts were right. She believes the Twilight's Hammer did not expect such a direct response, and calls the reagents marvelous.

faq.q: Who is asking me to carry the samples?
faq.answer: Claire is trapped in the cave and says she is too weak to carry the samples.

faq.q: What do I bring to Ashe Amberhall?
faq.answer: You bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Why can't Claire carry the samples?
faq.answer: Claire says their energy overwhelms her and that she is too weak to carry them.

faq.q: Where do I take the catalyst?
faq.answer: Take the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: What does Ashe say about the reagents?
faq.answer: Ashe says Claire's instincts were right and calls the reagents marvelous.
